subject: DSMs that include fully stratified detection functions?

messages.author: c9eec36a3a9e119a
messages.subject: DSMs that include fully stratified detection functions?
parts:
Question-

Say your best fitting detection is fully stratified (a separate detection function is fit to each variable). Is it possible to incorporate these results into your  DSM analysis? 

Up unto this point, my best fitting ds objects that have then been used in for density surface modeling were fit using MCDS. I suddenly have results saying that the "fully stratified" detection functions are preferred (based on AIC), and I don't know how to include each of these individual objects in the DSM.

Thanks!

messages.author: 350dad0a615d36db
messages.subject: Re: [distance-sampling] DSMs that include fully stratified detection functions?
parts:
Hi Katy, hi listfolk,

This is possible in theory but not implemented in the dsm package at the
moment. It's on my todo list (and has been for a wee bit). Hopefully I
will get to it very soon!

cheers,
--dave
